### Summary

When I try to install PyQt5 into a Python 3.12 environment using uv, I get a message telling me that no wheel is available for 64-bit Windows.  But, Google reports that the following PyQt5 wheels exist for Python 3.12:

Available Official Wheels (CPython 3.8+ / abi3)

• Windows x86-64: PyQt5-5.15.11-cp38-abi3-win_amd64.whl
• Windows x86-32: PyQt5-5.15.11-cp38-abi3-win32.whl
• Linux (glibc 2.17+ x86-64): PyQt5-5.15.11-cp38-abi3-manylinux_2_17_x86_64.whl
• macOS (Intel x86-64, macOS 11.0+): PyQt5-5.15.11-cp38-abi3-macosx_11_0_x86_64.whl
• macOS (Apple Silicon ARM64, macOS 11.0+): PyQt5-5.15.11-cp38-abi3-macosx_[1](https://pypi.org/project/PyQt5/)1_0_arm64.whl

Here's what I did and the resulting error message:

uv add PyQt5

error: Distribution `pyqt5-qt5==5.15.19 @ registry+[https://pypi.org/simple`](https://pypi.org/simple) can't be installed
because it doesn't have a source distribution or wheel for the current platform

hint: You're on Windows (`win_amd64`), but `pyqt5-qt5` (v5.15.19) only has wheels for the
following platforms: `manylinux2014_x86_64`, `macosx_10_13_x86_64`, `macosx_11_0_arm64`;
consider adding "sys_platform == 'win32' and platform_machine == 'AMD64'" to
`tool.uv.required-environments` to ensure uv resolves to a version with compatible wheels

### Platform

Windows 11 x64

### Version

0.13.0

### Python version

Python 3.12
